caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, stoneware crock or jar placed centrally against a plain, light-colored background. The object is barrel-shaped with a slightly narrower base and a wide, open mouth, revealing a dark brown or reddish-brown interior. The exterior of the crock is light gray or beige with subtle patches of discoloration or staining. A horizontal blue band or line circles the upper third of the vessel. On the upper left side, a decorative blue feather or leaf motif extends downwards, and on the right side, there is a small, curved handle with blue accents at the attachment points. Shadows and color gradients are used to indicate the roundness and three-dimensionality of the vessel. Handwritten text is faintly visible below the image.
title: Stoneware Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
